title: kbtail.py drops a coord change that comes less than 5 s after a rescan, so a new session waits for the 30 s timer
goal: kbtail.py rescans for sessions within 5 seconds of a coord change also when the change comes less than 5 s after the last rescan, so a session that starts then is shown within 12 seconds

run:
import json, os, random, shutil, string, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time, uuid
if os.name == "nt":
    print("check skipped: a fake claude process needs a POSIX host"); sys.exit(0)
R = os.getcwd(); T = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp()); C = os.path.join(T, "cfg"); S = os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite")
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_")}
env.update(CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=C, COLUMNS="200", KB_COORD_STORE=S)
def sh(*a, cwd=T):
    return subprocess.run(a, cwd=cwd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
K = os.path.join(T, "clone"); os.makedirs(K)
sh("git", "init", "-q", ".", cwd=K)
sh("git", "-c", "user.email=a@example.com", "-c", "user.name=n", "commit", "-q", "--allow-empty", "-m", "i", cwd=K)
shutil.copy(os.path.join(R, "backlog.json"), K); os.makedirs(os.path.join(K, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
os.makedirs(os.path.join(T, "bin")); FAKE = os.path.join(T, "bin", "claude"); os.symlink("/bin/sleep", FAKE)
procs = []
def transcript(base, sid, text):
    pdir = os.path.join(C, "projects", "".join(c if c.isalnum() else "-" for c in base)); os.makedirs(pdir, exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(pdir, sid + ".jsonl"), "w") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps({"type": "user", "cwd": base, "sessionId": sid, "timestamp": "2026-10-26T10:00:00Z",
                            "message": {"role": "user", "content": text}}) + "\n")
def session(base, text):
    sid = str(uuid.uuid4())
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(base, "_cache", "coord_hook"), exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(base, "_cache", "coord_hook", sid + ".json"), "w") as f:
        json.dump({"items": [], "lease_until": time.time() + 600, "token": "t"}, f)
    sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "coord.py"), "--store", S, "claim", "session/" + sid, "--ttl", "600", "--holder", "h")
    transcript(base, sid, text)
    procs.append(subprocess.Popen([FAKE, "120"], cwd=base))
    return sid, procs[-1].pid
def kbtail(*a):
    return sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "kbtail.py"), "--root", K, *a)
import threading
def follow(*a, e=None):
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "kbtail.py"), "--root", K, *a], cwd=T, env=e or env,
                         stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    lines = []
    threading.Thread(target=lambda: [lines.append(x) for x in p.stdout], daemon=True).start()
    return p, lines
def until(pred, s):
    end = time.monotonic() + s
    while time.monotonic() < end and not pred():
        time.sleep(0.1)
    return pred()
WT = os.path.join(K, ".claude", "worktrees", "agent-ST-aaaaaaaa")
sh("git", "worktree", "add", "-q", "-b", "work/ST-aaaaaaaa", WT, cwd=K)
WT2 = os.path.join(K, ".claude", "worktrees", "agent-ST-bbbbbbbb")
sh("git", "worktree", "add", "-q", "-b", "work/ST-bbbbbbbb", WT2, cwd=K)
try:
    session(WT, "planted-first-line")
    p, lines = follow()
    if not until(lambda: any("planted-first-line" in x for x in lines), 15):
        print("check broken: the first session is not shown"); sys.exit(2)
    time.sleep(1.0)
    session(WT2, "planted-late-line")
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    seen = until(lambda: any("planted-late-line" in x for x in lines), 12)
    took = time.monotonic() - t0
    p.terminate(); p.wait(5)
finally:
    for q in procs: q.kill()
ok = seen and took <= 12
print("ok (%.1f s)" % took if ok else "a session that starts just after a rescan is shown only after %.1f s (limit 12 s; the 30 s timer finds it)" % took)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
